questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Memory benefits from retrieval and review rather than familiarity alone.
options: Memory benefits from retrieval and review rather than familiarity alone.
Recognising a word guarantees being able to use it.
Memory preserves every detail unchanged.
Reading an answer is always the same as recalling it.

source.en: Effective study therefore combines understanding with repeated attempts to use knowledge in contexts that differ from the original example.
source.tr: Bu nedenle etkili çalışma anlamayı, bilgiyi ilk örnekten farklı bağlamlarda tekrar kullanma denemeleriyle birleştirir.
